categories.main_business_segments: Compeq Manufacturing Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the production and sales of printed circuit boards (PCBs), including rigid PCBs, high-density interconnect (HDI) boards, high-layer count boards (HLC), flexible PCBs (FPC), and rigid-flex PCBs. Additionally, the company provides surface-mount technology (SMT) assembly services. Their products serve various sectors such as information technology, communications, networking, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, satellite communications, and data centers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including laser drilling for microvias, high aspect ratio plating, semi-additive processes (mSAP), and precision line/space capabilities down to 20/20 microns. They emphasize high-frequency, high-speed material applications, embedded components, and advanced surface treatments. Smart factory initiatives, automation, AI-assisted inspection (AVI, AOI), and environmental management systems (ISO 14001) are integral to their production methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Compeq serves major customers in sectors such as AI servers, data centers, satellite communications, automotive electronics (including ADAS and autonomous driving systems), smartphones, tablets, laptops, and consumer electronics. Key customers include global server OEMs, communication equipment manufacturers, and consumer device brands. The company’s sales are diversified across multiple end markets with a focus on high-growth technology segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing facilities and sales offices in Taiwan (Taoyuan), Mainland China (Huizhou, Chongqing, Suzhou), Thailand, and Hong Kong. Its revenue is primarily generated from Asia, with significant sales also in the United States and other global markets. The company maintains a global footprint to support customers worldwide and optimize production costs.
categories.supply_chain_position: Compeq operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain as a manufacturer of PCBs and provider of SMT assembly services. It sources raw materials such as copper foil and chemicals from established suppliers and supplies finished circuit boards to OEMs and EMS providers downstream. The company also engages in investment and trading activities through subsidiaries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic R&D focus includes developing advanced PCB technologies for high-frequency, high-speed applications in AI servers, data centers, satellite communications, automotive electronics, and emerging fields like AR/VR and robotics. It invests heavily in process innovation, smart factory automation, environmental sustainability, and materials development. Future R&D plans emphasize next-generation mSAP processes, embedded heat dissipation solutions, and enhanced inspection technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Compeq generates revenue primarily through the sale of PCBs and SMT assembly services. Revenue is derived from contract manufacturing agreements with major electronics OEMs and suppliers. The company also earns income from investment subsidiaries and trading activities. Its revenue is largely transactional based on product sales volume and pricing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Compeq positions itself as a leading Taiwanese PCB manufacturer with a strong foothold in high-end HDI and multi-layer PCB markets. It competes globally by leveraging advanced technology, quality certifications, and a diversified product portfolio. The company emphasizes environmental compliance and customer service to differentiate itself in a competitive industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Compeq reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$72.46 billion, an 8% increase from the previous year, with net profit of NT$5.6 billion, up 34%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability over recent years, supported by expanding production capacity and market demand. Total assets stood at NT$85.26 billion with equity of NT$44.47 billion as of end-2024, reflecting a solid financial position.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Compeq emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced PCB products tailored for demanding applications such as AI servers, satellite communications, and automotive electronics. Its value proposition includes superior manufacturing precision, environmental sustainability leadership, smart factory capabilities, and comprehensive customer support from product development to after-sales service. The company aims to be a green partner and innovation leader in the PCB industry.
